final: WITH category_totals AS (SELECT category, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining, SUM(amount - spent) AS total FROM budget WHERE amount > 75 GROUP BY category), overall AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_total FROM category_totals) SELECT category_totals.category, category_totals.avg_remaining, category_totals.total, category_totals.total - overall.avg_total AS above_average FROM category_totals CROSS JOIN overall WHERE category_totals.total > overall.avg_total
